tidbit: Did you know… about 11,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by Reuters: An ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting a device appears to have Saudi backing, according to a court filing.
Confirmed by The Guardian: Calls are growing to strengthen workplace privacy in Australia as employers turn to artificial intelligence to track staff.
Confirmed by HRTech Series: Cornerstone has unveiled Cornerstone Workforce Planning and Cornerstone Agent Ready tools for workforce planning and agent governance.
Confirmed by The Business Times: The Fed sees the artificial intelligence boom adding to inflation concerns and is considering rate hikes.
Reported by 财新: Pan Gongsheng says policy considerations and preparations for artificial intelligence's impact on finance should be made prospectively.
Free every hour.
